description: Second annual storytelling festival from the Ra'anana Municipal Library and the Mishkan: music, literature and creativity for the whole family — a Nurit Galron concert, talks by Gil Hovav and Prof. Dan Ariely, film screenings and children's theatre. Full programme and tickets via the municipality.
location: Mishkan for Music and Arts, HaPalmach 2a, Ra'anana
title: Ze Kol HaSipur — Storytelling Festival
